summary: Chapter 2 follows Feuz's investigation of the parallel Vogel and Melchior files, but in doing so it renames the victim, invents an autopsy and poisoning for Melchior, gives Stettler the wrong office, relocates Berta into Feuz's household, and gives young Feuz twenty years of career experience.

issues.fix_hint: Restore the canonical name Klara Vogel; cut the invented first name 'Anna' and the invented maiden name 'geborene Aebi', which also falsely implies kinship to the Aebischer family.

issues.unit: drei Blätter, ein Protokoll, ein Sektionsbefund
issues.fix_hint: Cut the Sektionsbefund from the Melchior file; canon states Feuz filed the certificate without an autopsy.

issues.unit: das man im Magen gefunden hatte
issues.fix_hint: Remove the poison/stomach-contents detail; Melchior's cause of death is the fall of ~12m into the Chrachen, not poisoning.
Call him Amtsarzt, as canon does, not Amtsstatthalter; this recurs later as 'den Amtsstatthalter' and should be corrected throughout.

issues.unit: Zu Hause hatte Berta die Suppe schon aufgetragen
issues.fix_hint: Do not place Berta in Feuz's home serving him; she is Melchior's widow, not Feuz's domestic. Set this beat in her own household or cut the housekeeping detail.

issues.unit: Feuz hatte in zwanzig Jahren keinen Amtsstatthalter
issues.fix_hint: Cut or shorten the twenty-year span; canon records Feuz as young, not a twenty-year veteran of the office.

issues.unit: der Pfarrer stand in der Tür
issues.fix_hint: Name him Rutz (or Pfarrer Rutz) explicitly in this scene so the confession beat is unambiguously with the same man introduced as the creditor, not a second, unnamed priest.
